name: Sealed Sin'dorei Orders
summary: Sealed Sin'dorei Orders are an official diplomatic dispatch drafted by Ambassador Sunsorrow in the Undercity. Bound for Advisor Sorrelon at the Sepulcher, the sealed letter serves to coordinate blood elf efforts and observations among their new Forsaken allies in Silverpine Forest.

sections.title: Diplomatic Correspondence
sections.body: The orders are drafted by Ambassador Sunsorrow, who resides within the Royal Quarter of the Undercity serving as the diplomatic face of Quel'Thalas. Addressed to Advisor Sorrelon stationed at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest, the missive provides official guidance on operating alongside the Forsaken. Beyond formal instructions, the dispatch notes high regard for the courier who carried Lady Sylvanas Windrunner's recovered necklace, while urging careful conduct so as not to damage the fledgling ties binding the sin'dorei to the Horde.

faq.q: What are the Sealed Sin'dorei Orders?
faq.answer: They are a confidential official dispatch written by Ambassador Sunsorrow in the Undercity. They contain instructions for Advisor Sorrelon, the sin'dorei representative stationed at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Who wrote these orders and why?
faq.answer: Ambassador Sunsorrow penned them after the return of Lady Sylvanas Windrunner's long-lost necklace. He dispatched the courier to Silverpine Forest with instructions to help maintain stable, respectful relations with their new undead allies.

While delivered sealed, Advisor Sorrelon reveals upon opening that Sunsorrow commended the courier's service to Quel'Thalas. The missive also addresses navigating relations with the Forsaken and urges travelers to remain on their best behavior to protect their bond with the Horde.

faq.q: Where must the orders be delivered?
aliases: where do i take the orders
faq.answer: The orders are addressed to Advisor Sorrelon at the Sepulcher, a weathered crypt and settlement in northern Silverpine Forest, situated along the road south from the Tirisfal Glades border.

angles.text: The document highlights the fragile, nascent relationship between the sin'dorei and the Horde, urging elf emissaries to avoid causing friction among the Forsaken.
Though written by high-born elven diplomats who find the undead and their decrepit crypts rather jarring, the orders mandate respectful cooperation with Forsaken leadership.
